metadata.title: CTCLoss with empty target doesn't work well

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



CTCLoss doesn't provide the correct gradient when the target sequence is empty.

trigger_conditions.pattern: Empty Sequence Gradient Failure in Loss Functions
trigger_conditions.condition: Calling sequence loss functions with empty target sequences or zero-length labels and performing backward computation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: CTCLoss is called with at least one empty target sequence, e.g., label_sizes contains 0.

failure_behavior.description: CTCLoss is called with at least one empty target sequence, e.g., label_sizes contains 0.
